links.outcome: LLM answer quality (relevance, correctness, helpfulness, safety) on patient lab-result questions versus peers and other LLMs
links.effect: GPT-4 scored better than all other LLMs and human answers on all 4 aspects, but some GPT-4 responses were inaccurate or not individualized.
links.quote: The results of the win rate and medical expert evaluation both showed that GPT-4's responses achieved better scores than all the other LLM responses and human responses on all 4 aspects (relevance, correctness, helpfulness, and safety).

unlisted_practices: Prompt engineering and prompt augmentation to improve LLM responses to patient lab questions
LLM-based evaluator (win rate) to judge response quality

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates and compares the performance and safety of multiple LLMs versus human peer responses on laboratory test Q&As, but it benchmarks model outputs without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
